name: Lawrenceville United
notes: Resident-driven community org, distinct from Lawrenceville Corporation (which is development-focused). Very active.

name: Lawrenceville Corporation
notes: Commercial/development arm. Maintains a directory of Lawrenceville businesses and events at lvpgh.com.

name: Morningside Area Community Council
notes: Not an RCO but likely holds regular public meetings.

name: Shadyside Action Coalition
notes: Website redirects to sca2022.com. Covers Shadyside neighborhood issues.

name: Stanton Heights Neighborhood Association
notes: Active website. Found via ProPublica IRS data.

name: Strip District Neighbors
notes: Active website. The Strip District Business Association is separate (S40 NTEE).

name: Crafton Heights Community Organization (CHCO)
notes: Active website at chco.org. Not findable by domain-guessing (chco is not obvious).

name: Central Northside Neighborhood Council (CNNC)
notes: Also accessible at cnnc.org. Covers Central Northside / Mexican War Streets area.

name: Regent Square Civic Association
notes: Regent Square spans Pittsburgh and Swissvale; the civic assn covers the Pittsburgh portion.

name: Sheraden
notes: sheradenpgh.org confirmed live. Org name not fully confirmed — verify.

name: Troy Hill Citizens
notes: WordPress blog exists (troyhillcitizens.wordpress.com) but appears broken. Facebook is likely primary web presence. Found via ProPublica.

name: Knoxville Community Council
notes: Active org — monthly meetings, cleanups, school supply drives. Led by Sharonda Ellison. Featured on Hilltop Alliance site. Facebook is primary web presence. No standalone website found.

name: Overbrook Community Council
notes: Found via ProPublica IRS data (S21 = community coalitions). No working website found.

name: Arlington Civic Council
notes: Hosts National Night Out and summer block parties. Facebook is primary web presence. No standalone website found.

name: Northview Heights Citizens Council
notes: Found via ProPublica (NTEE P20 = human services). May be more social services than civic events.

name: Beechview Revitalization Advisory Group (BRAG)
notes: Active website at beechviewing.org. Founded under Pittsburgh Hispanic Development Corporation. Claims RCO status on website (/rco page) but NOT on official city Jan 2026 list — may have registered since then or be pending. Focus: inclusive economic development, business support.

name: Overbrook West Neighbors
notes: Active org focused on Upper Lancaster Ave Business Corridor. Claims RCO status on website but NOT on official city Jan 2026 list. Distinct from the older Overbrook Community Council (nrco-13). BIPOC business investment focus.

name: Strip District Business Association
notes: Business improvement-focused, less likely to have neighborhood events. Strip District Neighbors (nrco-06) is the residential org.

name: 31st Ward Community Action Group
meeting_location: Lincoln Place Presbyterian Church, 1202 Muldowney Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15207
notes: Serves Lincoln Place, Hays, New Homestead, and Gates Manor. Active and appears well-organized.

name: South Oakland Neighborhood Group (SONG)
meeting_location: Frazier Field House, 3716 Frazier St, Pittsburgh, PA 15213
notes: Resident-run group for South Oakland. Open public meetings.

name: West End-Elliott Citizens Council (WEECC)
notes: Serves West End and Elliott neighborhoods. HTTP-only site with cert issues — check weecc.org for current schedule.

name: California-Kirkbride Neighbors
notes: Primary community partner with Tree Pittsburgh for neighborhood greening. Facebook is primary web presence.
